text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, whew, whew...
Did I manage... to finish the run? But...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what is this? My legs feel... so heavy...
It's like...
(Whooooosh......)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(It feels like I just trudged through heavy snow.
My legs are exhausted all the way to my toes...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (So this is... the Japanese Derby...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*, *pant*...
Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right!? Do you need some energy!?
Here, have some water too...!

I rush over to an unusually exhausted Kitasan Black.
From behind her...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Kitasan Black...?
You look pretty devastated...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be the distance? There are quite a lot
of Umamusume who end up like this in the Derby..."
It took quite a long time before Kitasan Black was able to speak normally again.
choice_data_list: Are you feeling all right now, Kitasan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, somehow...
Though I was surprised. I thought I had plenty of confidence in my toughness.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Was being that exhausted
due to the weight of the Derby?
Or was it something else...

After much consideration, I decided to tell her.
About the single concern that had been whispered around.
choice_data_list: I recall someone saying it might be the “distance”
Someone was saying it might be the “distance,” you know

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Distance... Are you saying 2400m
is too long for me?

I don't know the real reason. After all, today was
her first time running in a GⅠ race of 2400m or more.
As a Trainer, I thought she could handle long distances based on her running form. But judging from today's run, I couldn't say for sure.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wonder... Maybe I'm actually
better suited for shorter distances...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I was just running as hard as I could
without really paying attention to the distance, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "No, no, Kitasan Black-san, there is no need to worry!"

Sakura Bakushin O, who had been listening in,
confidently interjected into the conversation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Getting tired today was just a fluke. There's no doubt about it, so please don't worry!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san,
how did you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~, goes without saying!
Just who do you think your special coach is?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I am Sakura Bakushin O! An Umamusume who has
conquered the long distance of 1200m × 3 multiple times!"

"As far as I know, Sakura Bakushin O is a sprint expert.
She has delivered great performances in numerous sprint GⅠs until now."

Still, I've never heard of an interpretation
where 1200m × 3 = 3600m = long distance.
Sounds like bizarre cosmic nonsense to me, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If Bakushin O says so,
I feel like everything will be all right, Trainer!
choice_data_list: No, it's just my imagination, surely...

text_block_list.text:
I lightly stopped Kitasan Black,
who was about to fall for it.

We'll have to put her distance aptitude on hold for now
and figure it out as we go.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if it's true that I'm really not
suited for longer distances...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
3,000m... The Kikuka Sho in the autumn
might be even tougher.
I have to fire myself up and train hard!
